_why: The design screens and primitives are not builder inputs — only the five CSS files in ImladrisAssetBuilder::CSS_SOURCES are. Without this digest the mirror could be re-synced with a reordered, renamed or deleted admin screen and every gate stayed green. This proves nothing about fidelity; it says only 'the design you adopted against has changed, go and look'.
_owner: Whoever syncs docs/design-system/imladris/ refreshes this in the same commit: php bin/build-imladris-assets.php --print-design-digest. This is deliberately NOT config/imladris-runtime-baseline.json, which is refreshed once per merge on main by the merger (ADR 0024 obligation 4) and which no slice branch may contain a change to.
